description_en: Imports external data to IoT Platform. Data imported through this API is referred to as API data source data. You can upload data from on-premises systems or other platforms to IoT Platform for data analysis and processing
description_zh: 调用该接口向物联网平台导入外部数据。通过此API导入物联网平台的数据，称为API数据源的数据。您可将本地或其他平台的数据上传至物联网平台，用于数据的分析和处理
kebab_example: aliyun iot add-data-for-api-source --iot-instance-id iot-0pp1n00000 --api-id cxatswiniekxw000 --content key_:_value_,_ts_:1637658200000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDataForApiSource

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The API data source ID, which is the API ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the API ID of the API data source on the Data Analytics > Data Collection > Data Source page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<props="china">For more information about API data sources, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/307003.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
API数据源ID，即API ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的数据分析 > 数据采集 > 数据源页面，查看API数据源的API ID。</ph></props>

<props="china">API数据源的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/307003.html。</props>
parameters.name: api_id

parameters.help_en:
The data content to upload to IoT Platform. The value is in JSON format.
The JSON must contain the ts field, which indicates the point in time when the data is generated (a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds)
parameters.help_zh:
上传到物联网平台的数据内容。JSON格式。
JSON中必须包含ts字段，用来表示数据产生的时间点（unix 毫秒精度的时间戳）
parameters.name: content
